footer.tagline: Car, scooter and quad rental in Costa Smeralda. 24/7 VIP delivery at Olbia Airport, Isola Bianca Port and across north-eastern Sardinia.

subtitle.airport: No queues at terminal desks, no transfers, no waiting. We deliver your vehicle directly on arrival at Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport.
subtitle.port: No queues at the port, no transfers after an 8-hour ferry crossing. You disembark and find your vehicle waiting at your ferry company's pier.
subtitle.station: Step off the train and find your vehicle ready. No taxis, no waiting, no queues at downtown rental desks.
subtitle.generic: No desk queues, no transfers, no waiting. We deliver your vehicle when and where you need it — airport, port, hotel or villa.

step1.title: 1. Message us on WhatsApp
step1.text: Tell us the date, your arrival time and the vehicle you want. We confirm within 30 minutes — also in English or French.

text.airport: We track your flight in real time via FlightAware: if you're delayed, we adjust delivery at no extra cost up to 4 hours.
text.port: We track the actual disembarkation time of Moby, Tirrenia, GNV and Grimaldi: if your ship is late, we wait for you.
text.station: Send us your Trenitalia train number: we monitor platform arrival time and coordinate around the actual schedule.
text.generic: We track your flight or ferry: if you're late, we adjust delivery at no extra cost.

title.port: 3. We meet you at the pier
title.station: 3. We meet you at the platform exit

text.airport: Our staff will be at the Costa Smeralda arrivals terminal with a sign showing your name. Vehicle pre-cooled and refuelled.
text.port: Our staff at your ferry company's pier (also for night ferries at 6:00 AM). Vehicle ready at the ship, pre-cooled and refuelled.
text.station: Our staff at the platform exit of Olbia station. Vehicle parked nearby, pre-cooled and refuelled.
text.generic: We meet you at arrivals or at the port with the vehicle pre-cooled and refuelled.

step4.title: 4. Off you go
step4.text: Quick tablet signature, driving licence photo, keys in hand. You're on the road in 5 minutes: no queues, no desks, no extra transfers.
